content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-without-paypal-honest-side-side-breakdown-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators|complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online|Everything About]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates for crypto requires a sovereign digital commerce stack, which is a set of free and paid tools that give creators full control over their online stores, payment processing, and data ownership. This is not a workaround, but base-layer infrastructure that allows creators to bypass platform fees and retain 99.5% of sales revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This combination of tools allows creators to deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Selling digital products for crypto can be a lucrative business, but it requires the right infrastructure to bypass platform fees and retain 99.5% of sales revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks and full source code. These components allow creators to build, deploy, and scale a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is: How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe? The answer is: With a sovereign digital commerce stack, which allows creators to bypass platform fees and retain 99.5% of sales revenue. This is achieved by using free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround, but base-layer infrastructure that allows creators to take control of their online stores, payment processing, and data ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, and templates for crypto, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. By using this kit, creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. To learn more about the Complete Builder Kit and other products, creators can visit the Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can follow these steps: Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account and set up hosting for their online store. Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Deploy their online store and configure automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a sovereign digital commerce stack?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a set of free and paid tools that give creators full control over their online stores, payment processing, and data ownership. This allows creators to bypass platform fees and retain 99.5% of sales revenue.
How do I configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with NOWPayments?

To configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with NOWPayments, creators need to integrate their NOWPayments account with their online store and configure the payment gateway to use on-chain crypto payments.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with other payment gateways?
No, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to work with on-chain crypto payments only, and not with traditional payment gateways like PayPal or Stripe.
How do I configure instant product delivery with a sovereign digital commerce stack?

To configure instant product delivery with a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators need to integrate their online store with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script and configure the delivery logic to use instant product delivery.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with my existing online store?

Yes, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with their existing online store by integrating the stack with their existing store and configuring the payment gateway and delivery logic to use the sovereign digital commerce stack.
